title: Fail-loud font guard is a no-op: loader falls back to the raylib default which passes IsFontValid
detail: Hard bar (c): 'the font loader FAILS LOUDLY — app + harness refuse the raylib default (the silent-fallback lie is impossible)'. A missing/corrupt TTF returns GetFontDefault(), which passes IsFontValid, so the os.exit(2) guards never fire.
recommended_fix: Make load_font_file/load_fonts report load success (or detect the default: compare glyphCount/texture against GetFontDefault()); exit(2) on any family load failure; delete the GetFontDefault belt+braces returns.

detail: The verb's own comments warn 'a quiet fallback lies', yet its baseline probe references an asset this PR deletes: LoadFontEx returns GetFontDefault() on the missing file, IsFontValid passes, and the probe prints verdicts for the raylib default as 'baseline'.
recommended_fix: Point the baseline probe at a shipped font (e.g. assets/fonts/ibm_plex_sans_regular.ttf) or drop it; make glyph_probe fail loudly when the target file is absent.

title: Replay driver duplicated: overlay_check keeps its inline loop beside the new run_demo_to_ms copy
detail: The font job added run_demo_to_ms as a 'shared replay driver' but left overlay_check's inline stepping loop (and pasted the comment twice). Two copies of the driver can drift.
recommended_fix: Refactor overlay_check to call run_demo_to_ms (preserving its hash collection), or at minimum delete the duplicated comment block.

title: Comments still claim the draw helper 'truncates every rune to a byte' — behavior this PR removed
detail: This PR replaced the rune->byte truncation with raw-UTF-8 draw_text_font and a ⚠-capable atlas, so both 'truncates every rune to a byte' claims (and the '!!'-instead-of-⚠ rationale) are now false.
recommended_fix: Update both comments; the crisis banner may now draw the real atlas-merged ⚠ (coverage is test-pinned in font_test.odin) if desired.
